fact: On 28 October 2025 the Treasury inaugurated new premises for its Direction des systèmes d'information, housing the backup data-entry room and technical support call centre, with the director stating it ensures security and permanent availability of the Treasury's critical systems.
title: TRÉSOR PUBLIC: La Direction des systèmes d'information se dote de nouveaux locaux
publisher: Direction Générale du Trésor et de la Comptabilité Publique
